# # CI runners
#
# Some actions use Runs-On to run on ASF infrastructure:
# https://datafusion.apache.org/contributor-guide/#ci-runners
#
# Small, short jobs run on `ubuntu-slim`, which starts quickly even when the
# shared `ubuntu-latest` pool is backed up. A job belongs there if it stays
# well within one vCPU, 5 GB of memory, and 15 minutes, and needs no Docker.
# Slim has no Rust toolchain; slim jobs that run Cargo set up Rust with
# `.github/actions/setup-rustup`.
#
# # `cargo xtask`
#
# Individual CI commands are implemented with `cargo xtask` to make them easier
# to reproduce locally.
#
# See `xtask/README.md` for details about DataFusion's `xtask` tooling.
#
# It is being rolled out incrementally across all workflows.
# Track progress at https://github.com/apache/datafusion/issues/24487.
#
# # Pushes to `main`
#
# Commits reach upstream `main` through the merge queue, which runs this
# workflow at the same SHA. A push to upstream `main` therefore runs only the
# jobs that save caches, publish coverage, or run the non-required FFI check.
# The other jobs carry an `if:` that skips them for that event alone. PRs, the
# merge queue, `workflow_dispatch`, and every other branch run all jobs. A
# direct push that bypasses the queue is not re-checked; dispatch the workflow
# on `main` for a full run. `ci/scripts/check_rust_workflow_skips.py` keeps
# the skipped set explicit.
#
# # Pull requests from forks
#
# A PR from a fork runs this workflow on the fork, on the contributor's own
# runners, except macOS, which runs upstream, including in the merge queue.
# `fork_ci_status.yml` mirrors that run as the `Rust (fork)` check
# on the PR. Upstream runs `check-fmt`, `check-workflow-tool-installs`, and
# `examples-check-datafusion-crates` for such a PR; the other jobs carry an
# `if:` that skips them. The merge queue runs every job on the merged result,
# so it stays the gate. PRs from branches in this repository, and fork PRs to
# release branches, which have no merge queue, run every job here, as before.
#
name: Rust

concurrency:
  # Fork pushes cancel superseded runs on the same branch. Upstream main and
  # merge queue runs keep separate groups for each SHA.
  group: ${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.head_ref || (github.repository == 'apache/datafusion' && github.sha || github.ref) }}-${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

on:

    branches-ignore:
      - 'gh-readonly-queue/**'
      - 'dependabot/**'
    paths-ignore:
      - "docs/**"
      - "**.md"
      - ".github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/**"
      - ".github/pull_request_template.md"
  pull_request:
  # manual trigger
  # https://docs.github.com/en/actions/managing-workflow-runs/manually-running-a-workflow
  workflow_dispatch:
  merge_group:

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
